purpose: Tokenizes primary account numbers (PANs) for payment services to prevent storing clear text PANs.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: The tokenization-service accepts a PAN, validates its format and returns a token.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: The database runs as a primary with a standby in a second availability zone.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: The service runs in the vault private subnet and consists of the tokenization-service, vault-db (PostgreSQL) and Vault and KMS.
